headline: PROP sector leads with PF jumping +25.00% on an open price gap while EVER posts a +66.70% gain over five days.
market_take: Today's coverage shows strong upside in PROP, highlighted by PF's +25.00% price gap and solid volume in KUN (+14.81%) and NVD (+14.55%). FOOD delivered mixed moves, with F&D up +18.75% and XBIO intraday +14.29% but AQUA slipping -9.09% on an open gap. CONS experienced pressure, notably TPOLY down -16.67% over five days and a -8.33% open gap, while DEMCO managed a modest +7.95% intraday rise. Unusual‑trading alerts were dominated by large volume spikes (e.g., TIF1, QHOP, M-PAT) and extreme price gaps, and several capital‑change and director filings could add further volatility.

sector_notes.note: PF surged +25.00% on an open price gap; KUN and NVD posted double‑digit gains with volume ratios above 11×. Recent filings include KC's termination of a convertible debenture and CMC's director changes, adding potential catalyst risk.

F&D rose +18.75% and XBIO recorded a +14.29% intraday move, supported by a high‑priority SET clarification filing for XBIO. AQUA fell -9.09% on an open gap with minimal volume, indicating liquidity pressure.

TPOLY declined -16.67% over five days and showed a -8.33% open gap; SOLAR also posted an -8.33% gap. DEMCO managed a +7.95% intraday rise, while APCS displayed a -100.00% open gap, suggesting possible delisting.

M-PAT experienced multiple alerts: a 5.1σ volume spike, a -21.21% price gap, and a +15.38% intraday move. QHOP and TIF1 recorded extreme volume spikes (>10σ), highlighting heightened trading activity.
